name: Value Chain in Agro-Food Processing
description: Agriculture production, productivity and technologies for enhancing them, biotic and abiotic stresses, cropping pattern, protected cultivation, postharvest management – components and techniques, processing and value addition of cereals, legumes, spices, oil seeds, millets, cash crops, pre-harvest and postharvest disease management, techniques of extending shelf life of agro produce, food grain storage and storage structures, modified packaging, principles and methods of food preservation, food additives, colorants and preservatives, methods for stabilization of food systems, waste and by-product utilization, food hazards, quality and safety of agro-foods, standards and regulations, trade and commerce of agricultural commodities, food safety management systems, schemes and programmes for postharvest management.
